critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2194 lines — split into routers (auth, finance, admin_admins, exports, customers, orders) is overdue for maintainability.

finance_update (PUT /admin/finance/transactions/{id}) still propagates only amount/currency/date to employee_wages; it does NOT re-link when category flips wage/non-wage or when recipient_employee_id changes on edit — leftover from V8 comment. Low likelihood but recommend delete+insert on wage-ness/recipient change.
Recharts container reports width/height(-1) briefly on /admin/finance — wrap chart in ResponsiveContainer with explicit min height, or defer render until layout ready to silence warnings.
employee_wages_summary iterates over all employees and does a per-employee find on employee_wages — N+1 pattern; consider single $group aggregation for scale.
export_customers/export_accounts do not filter deleted/inactive customers — acceptable but consider a status filter param for the UI.

xdist parallel run: module-level `_created_*` lists in test files are per-worker; TestZzzCleanup only sees its own worker's list. Left over from prior iterations too. I manually swept leaked TEST_ txns/admins/categories after this run; recommend switching to a query-based cleanup (`?q=TEST_`) or `-n 0` for these files.
AdminFinance.jsx txn-search-clear renders only when txnSearch truthy — matches UX; not a bug, but worth adding data-testid on a persistent placeholder if E2E scripts need to assert its absence.
